$comment: Compact-bundle size budget. Values are an upper bound on the exact canonical brotli-compressed byte length; the size-budget golden test fails if any committed bundle exceeds its budget. Each budget = measured canonical brotli + 15% headroom, rounded up to 128 bytes. Bump the budget (and document the data-growth justification) in the same PR that grows the source data. Do not invent budgets; always re-measure first.
